messages:
alex_chen: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — we need to assign owners for the action items and confirm timelines. I added a starter table in the doc: https://rwd.mn/pm/incident-2026. Can owners please claim or comment?

maria_gonzalez: I can take the post-incident QA checklist update. Will create a Jira and aim for EOW.

samir_kapoor: I can own the KV-cache eviction tuning recommendation. Question: do we want a small canary on Dedicated first?

taylor_ops: @samir_kapoor yes, prefer canary on Dedicated with 10% traffic for 48h before full rollout. Add that to the ticket.

jamie_prod: I'll own the customer-facing RCA writeup + messaging. I'll pair with @maria_gonzalez for the timeline.

alex_chen: Thanks. For tracking please put Jira IDs in the doc and mark R/A/C/I (R=Responsible, A=Accountable, C=Consulted, I=Informed). Quick template I used:
```
- Item: short desc
- Owner (R): 
- Accountable (A): 
- Consulted (C): 
- Informed (I): 
- Jira: PROJ-
- Target ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
```

maria_gonzalez: Added PROJ-912 for QA checklist. R: maria_gonzalez, A: alex_chen, C: eng-oncall, I: support. ETA: 2026-04-30.

samir_kapoor: Created PROJ-913 for cache tuning + canary. R: samir_kapoor, A: taylor_ops, C: eng-runtime, I: product. ETA: 2026-05-07.

taylor_ops: Noted. I'll schedule the canary window and tag infra on the ticket.

jamie_prod: Created PROJ-914 for RCA + customer comms. R: jamie_prod, A: maria_gonzalez, C: comms, I: customers@list. ETA: 2026-04-28.

alex_chen: Two cross-cutting asks: 1) we need someone to own a short monitoring spike detection rule for this class of KV evictions (low effort), 2) consolidate recurring incident pattern notes into the incident patterns tracker. Who can take 1?

maria_gonzalez: I can take the monitoring spike rule (low effort). Will attach PROJ-915 and add a test plan. ETA: 2026-04-22.

samir_kapoor: I'll add pattern notes to the incident patterns tracker and drop a short summary in the doc. Also linking to past incidents for context.

alex_chen: Great. For handoffs: after the canary succeeds, @samir_kapoor -> @taylor_ops will own rollout ops, and then @maria_gonzalez will update runbooks and tests. I'll update the RACI in the tracker.

oncall-bot: Incident follow-up reminder: check-in scheduled in 7 days. Use /reminder to modify.

jamie_prod: Small ask — can we do weekly 15m sync for two weeks to ensure no regressions post-rollout? Prefer Mon 10am PT.

taylor_ops: Monday 10am PT works for me. I'll put a calendar invite and mark as recurring for 2 weeks.

alex_chen: Thanks all. Action items summary: PROJ-912 (QA checklist) -> maria_gonzalez, PROJ-913 (cache tuning + canary) -> samir_kapoor, PROJ-914 (RCA) -> jamie_prod, PROJ-915 (monitoring rule) -> maria_gonzalez. Weekly sync Mon 10am PT x2. I'll close this thread once tickets are in the tracker and RACI is updated. :thumbsup:

maria_gonzalez: Done — tracker updated and Jira links are in the doc.

samir_kapoor: PROJ-913 updated with canary plan, tagging eng-runtime and infra.

jamie_prod: PROJ-914 draft ready, will send to comms for review tomorrow.

taylor_ops: Calendar invites sent. See you all Monday.

alex_chen: Closing loop — thanks everyone for quick ownership. If anything slips, ping this thread and we'll escalate.
